QuestInfo.name: Honor of the Explorers
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1022000##k, the Warrior Instructor of #b#m102000000##k, has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1022000# wants you to represent Explorers in #bBattle Mode#k. Aim for #bRank 9#k to bring honor to Explorers. Talk to #b#p9070004##k in any city to join Battle Mode.
QuestInfo.2: #p1022000# congratulated you for reaching Rank 9. Bring more honor to Explorers by achieving higher ranks!

0.0: Have you heard? They just opened #bBattle Mode#k in Maple World. Such a place is a true test of strength... Countless warriors testing their might in battle against each other... Alas, my work as a job instructor keeps me too busy to give it a try. All of us instructors are in the same boat.
0.1: Therefore, I'd like to make a request to you on behalf of all the job instructors. Will you participate in Battle Mode as a representative of the Explorers? I won't ask for the impossible, but you should try to reach #bRank 9#k. That should be enough to bring honor to the Explorers.

yes.0: I knew you would accept. See #b#p9070004# in any town#k and head over to Battle Square. I look forward to hearing about your accomplishments.

no.0: I had hoped you'd have a bit more spirit... I'm quite disappointed.

1.0: Ah, so you reached Rank 9 in Battle Mode. Well done. I knew you could do it! Your courage brings honor to all Explorers.

yes.0: Now that you've done this, I'd like to see you push yourself even further. Remember, every victory you gain is a victory for Explorers everywhere.

default.0: It looks like you haven't reached #bRank 9#k in #bBattle Mode#k... I truly believe that you have it in you. Please go see #b#p9070004# in any town#k.
